name: greeter
description: A small, stateless Go HTTP service exposing GET /hello and GET /farewell, each taking an optional name query parameter and returning a JSON greeting or farewell message. Built to the organization's Go service conventions (app-factory-kaj/e2e-reference): net/http, environment-based configuration with sensible defaults, wrapped errors, JSON error bodies. It does not persist anything, require authentication, or expose any endpoint beyond /hello and /farewell.
